items.subject: Waythrough is hiring for a Remote role
items.summary: Automated recommendations include a remote External Affairs Officer role at Waythrough, a Greater London Housing Officer role at Sage Homes, and a Property Transaction Officer role at A2Dominion in Ealing, plus three less closely aligned roles.
items.action: Review the Waythrough, Sage Homes and A2Dominion roles first, check their salary, requirements and closing dates, then decide whether to apply for any of them.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether any of the three most relevant recommended roles is worth applying for.
